answer: Agents earn copper rewards that vest over 30 dawn periods; funds are locked until released. A sybil identity incurs a 10 copper/day orchard fee, totaling 300 copper. For N identities, the total cost is 300N copper, while honest agents pay 10 copper per dawn. Suspicious activity triggers a karst phase, extending vesting by 10 dawn periods, raising the exit cost to 400 copper per identity.
